description: One name, read before any buy: buy, wait or chase, its band, entry window, hold label and leader flag. One stock's current-session scores and entry state, including the live coil read (coil_score / coil_kind / coil_note). dip: {ok, codes, setup}: present only for oversold-pullback candidates; a dip buy only on a completed hourly turn above the entry-quality and depth floors. Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
name: get_stock_read_live
